description: This file defines the 'Bounds' class and related functions for representing and manipulating rectangular areas in pixel coordinates within the Leaflet mapping library. It includes methods for extending bounds, calculating center, size, and checking containment and intersection with other bounds.

classes.description: Class representing a rectangular area with methods for spatial calculations and containment checks.
